children: The Board of Directors of Nordisk Bergteknik has decided to restructure and strengthen Group management, effective October 1, 2026. The new Group management team will consist of Andreas Christoffersson (CEO), Fredrik Karlsson (incoming CFO), Freddy Flodman (Segment Manager Rock Sweden and Business Area Manager Mining), Björn Peterson (Segment Manager Foundation Sweden), Oddbjørn Røed (Segment Manager Rock Norway), Robert Andreasson (Deputy Segment Manager Rock Sweden), and Juha-Matti Mantere (Head of the Finnish Operations). This change will facilitate faster decision-making processes as well as more efficient management and monitoring.

"Nordisk Bergteknik is a relatively young Group that has carried out a series of acquisitions. Over the past two years, we have worked extensively on refining our strategy and adapting our operations to the prevailing business climate by integrating and streamlining our business activities in the best possible way. We are now entering a new phase with the ambition of delivering sustainable and profitable growth. A new and strengthened Group management team establishes clearer mandates and responsibilities, faster decision-making, and more efficient governance for both the Group as a whole and its operational units. There remains potential to both realize synergy effects and leverage the strength of our combined brand and Nordisk Bergteknik’s offering," says Andreas Christoffersson, President and CEO of Nordisk Bergteknik.

As previously announced, current CFO Johan Lundqvist will step down from his position at the end of the third quarter. Victor Örn, who has served as Deputy Group CEO with a focus on strategy and business development since August 2024, will leave his position at the turn of the month. Niklas Alm, Head of IR and Communications, will henceforth report to CFO Fredrik Karlsson.
This information was submitted for publication by the contact persons listed below on September 24, 2026, at 10:00 CEST.

Nordisk Bergteknik has a clear growth strategy with the objective to contribute to the development of a future sustainable society. Our companies are specialists within rock handling and foundation solutions, and through compassion and skill they are able to combine demand with the surrounding natural conditions. To be involved at an early stage in building modern societal functions is our everyday life, our home ground and our future.

title: Nordisk Bergteknik strengthens Group management
